result.evidence: Frame 4560 is the cleanest capture: its bottom edge is free of the orange/reddish finger-like intrusion visible at the bottom edge in frames 4558 and 4559, and it shows the full room unobstructed (exposed brick column left, wall-mounted shelf, debris-strewn floor, window wall right). It also rates best on the advisory measures (highest focus laplacian variance 368.65 and highest mechanical score 0.7258).
